notes:
PASS on the fake backend; gate.digest is the digest line printed by the last gate run. Served device mhs://localhost/robosuite-baxter, kind world.sim, mode simulated, risk R0 (the card's floor and the R0 floors of cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1; a simulated MJCF model has no physical effect). The card's models[0], robosuite/models/assets/robots/baxter/robot.xml, is read in place from the pinned clone (never copied, imported, installed or modified). The card's entry_symbols were confirmed in the clone: MujocoMulti at robosuite/multi_agent/multi_robot_panda.py:126, Door at robosuite/environments/manipulation/door.py:13, Lift at lift.py:16, Lift at lift_without_smoothness_constraints.py:16 and NutAssemblySingle at nut_assembly.py:687. They construct a whole robosuite/gym scene (gym, numpy and robosuite), so this package serves the card's models[0] MJCF through the card's MujocoDriver, as PLAYBOOK.md section 8 directs for MuJoCo cards. The MJCF is the bare Baxter torso: 14 hinge joints, seven per arm (robot.xml:71-103 and 123-155), and 14 motor actuators with ctrlranges shoulder pan -50..50, shoulder lift -100..100, upper elbow -50..50, lower elbow -50..50, forearm roll -15..15, wrist angle -15..15 and wrist rotate -15..15, repeated for both arms (176-190). The bridge derives action.ctrl per actuator from those ctrlranges; the package declares no Limit of its own, so there is no site-limits.example.json. The model has no option timestep, so the stand-in fake uses a placeholder library default of 2 ms and publishes that stand-in value as timestep_ms (placeholder, not a model bound). The fake backend (fake.py) is a callable stand-in for the mujoco module that parses the same MJCF for the joint coordinates, ctrlranges and step and integrates a placeholder first-order motion; it is not MuJoCo and computes no meshes, contacts, equality constraints, inertias or actuator dynamics. The RethinkGripper that the robosuite wrapper attaches to each arm (baxter_robot.py:27-31) and the benchmark's multi-controller split (README.md:10) are not part of the bare robot model and are not served. MuJoCo itself was not installed and was never run. Expected simulator-family warnings only: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND (the backend is the package's stand-in for the mujoco library, so there is no recorded native surface) and G8.NO_UNIT x3 for the family-derived ticks, action.ctrl[*] and reset seed. G4 had no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. NOT COVERED: the MuJoCo engine; the robosuite scene composition and the multi-agent wrapper of the card's entry symbols; the other robot MJCF models of the card's models list and of the clone; the grippers, mounts, controllers and task objects that robosuite composes around the bare Baxter; cameras, rendering and sensors; snapshot/restore beyond the stand-in's own deterministic state (the bridge advertises snapshot_restore true from the stand-in, but it was not compared with the engine); and any physical Baxter hardware (no hardware run is claimed). The package is model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by is the model/run id and reviewed_by is null.
